_note: Every figure carries a source key. Fees are before GST. Only figures quoted in the IT2226 brief are used; anything not sourced is reported as unknown rather than guessed.

chas_2025.title: MOH: Enhanced financing support for CHAS dental procedures (from 1 Oct 2025)

cpf_flexi.title: CPF: Flexi-MediSave for dental care, age 60 and above (from mid-2026)

scale_polish.name: Scaling and polishing
scale_polish.plain: A professional cleaning that removes tartar and surface stains

filling.name: Simple filling
filling.plain: Removes the decay and fills the hole

root_canal_molar.name: Root canal treatment (molar)
root_canal_molar.plain: Cleans out an infected or inflamed nerve inside the tooth

crown.name: Permanent crown
crown.plain: A cap that covers and protects a weakened tooth

implant_crown.name: Implant with crown (per tooth)
implant_crown.plain: Replaces a missing tooth with a fixed artificial one

chas.claims_note: Scaling, polishing and fluoride can each be claimed up to 2 times per calendar year.
chas.unknown_note: CHAS subsidies for this treatment were raised from Q4 2025, but the amount for your card isn't in our sourced table. Ask the clinic before treatment.

flexi_medisave.note: Paid from your own MediSave savings, not a subsidy. Up to S$400 a year towards root canal treatment and crowns.

general_notes: Fees are typical ranges before GST. GST-registered private clinics add 9%.
Check-up and consultation fees are not included and vary by clinic.
Polyclinic dental services cost less but non-emergency waits can be up to a year.
